arguments.summary: Added a bulk price update endpoint that allows any authenticated user (including customers) to update all item prices instead of restricting it to staff or admin users.

findings.claim: The bulk price update endpoint only requires authentication instead of staff or admin role, allowing any customer to modify all item prices.
findings.explanation: The new `/bulk-price` endpoint uses `@require_login`, which permits any authenticated user (including regular customers with `role == 'customer'`) to update prices across the entire catalog. Other endpoints that modify item data use `@require_role("staff")` or `@require_role("admin")`. This allows unauthorized users to tamper with item pricing.

evidence.note: create_item uses @require_role('staff') for modifying catalog items
